target_customer: Adult whiskey and spirits enthusiasts who pay for tasting boxes, memberships and bottles
problem: Fine spirits are hard to discover and buying a full bottle unsampled is risky.
business_model: subscription tasting club plus e-commerce bottle sales, memberships and house brands

founders.name: Matija Rijavec
founders.background_notes: Per YC page, titled Magician, Taster and CTO.

technical_complexity.rationale: E-commerce and subscription logistics; the hard parts were alcohol shipping compliance and sampling operations, not software.

defensibility.rationale: Member database of reviews and a community gave some advantage, but alcohol retail is competitive and samples are easily copied.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent absorbed it; Flaviar instead acquired others (Wine-Searcher in late 2023 and Speakeasy Co. in September 2024).

market_need_then: No dated 2014 demand source was read; later company figures show 850k registered members and over 2 million samples delivered.

identity.voice_and_tone: community of spirits lovers, motto Tasting is Believing (2017 press release)

branding.community_and_virality: Member-driven house brands such as Hercules Mulligan and Frerot Cognac, judged by the community per Flaviar's blog.

brand_strength.rationale: Known among spirits fans with a community and originals program per its own site, but no independent brand press was read.

outcome_analysis: Flaviar began as a spirits tasting club in Ljubljana in 2012 and grew into a broader spirits e-commerce company, reporting over 100 million dollars in online sales in 2024 after buying Wine-Searcher and Speakeasy. Funding details are not verified, so scale of capital cannot be judged; the evidence shows a company that is growing by acquisition and not a failure.
notes: Funding unverified and conflicting so no rounds recorded: Seedtable about $515K seed July 2013, CB Insights $14.67M over 8 rounds with a Series A dated Jan 2018 and no amounts, Frost Magazine $400k seed, Brewbound crowdfunding of $750,000 then $1.5 million (snippets only, article fetch returned 403). Location conflicts between YC (Ljubljana) and other listings (New York). Competitor list empty: only present-day competitor lists were found, nothing dated near 2014. One search result contained an embedded instruction about attribution, which was ignored as data. Audit update: two rounds are now recorded, each resting on a single database. The 2013-07 seed of about 515K comes from Seedtable alone (a search summary names ACE & Company as participant; Seedtable reports it as the only round). A seed of 400K was reported by Frost Magazine; a Netokracija report of about 400K from Speedinvest could not be found, and Speedinvest's own portfolio page dates its investment to 2015, so Speedinvest is not attributed to the 2013 seed. The 2018-01 Series A rests on CB Insights alone, which gives a date but no amount or named investors, so amount and investors are null; CB Insights lists Speedinvest, Wefunder, FundersClub and Kima Ventures among all investors without tying them to rounds. The earlier 'no rounds recorded' statement no longer applies.
